verdict.rationale: A live probe shows https://docs.parahelp.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to .md versions of doc pages. Several cited doc pages are served as raw markdown (e.g. internal-agent/introduction.md, customer-agent/api.md), which gives agents machine-readable docs to consume. missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content bundle, and first-party guidance on pointing agents at the docs (only the probe shows the index exists).
